topic: How does the 14.6% bandwidth affect frequency planning for multi-satellite networks with adjacent channel interference risks?
consensus_response: The 14.6% bandwidth limitation affects frequency planning by increasing adjacent channel interference, reducing coverage probability and data rate. Optimized channel allocation balances interference reduction and resource utilization, while adaptive power control and beamforming techniques can mitigate interference. A trade-off exists between interference reduction and data rate degradation.
reference_context: Frequency reuse and orthogonal channels impact coverage probability and data rate in satellite constellations, with optimal channel allocation crucial for minimizing interference.
